title: Jelly Glazed Dutch Chicken Skewers
description: A high protein weeknight Dutch dish featuring shaoxing wine and binchotan charcoal, resulting in charred and glassy jelly glazed chicken skewers.
instructions: Preheat a wok over high heat with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil until it starts to smoke.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, then add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shaoxing wine, honey, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to the wok and cook until the sauce thickens and turns into a glassy jelly, about 5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the wok and toss to coat with the jelly glaze.
Thread the glazed chicken onto skewers.
Hold the skewers over the binchotan charcoal to achieve a charred exterior.
Serve the jelly glazed Dutch chicken skewers hot.
